name: sciatic nerve glide floss
description: A seated nerve glide that alternates straightening the leg and moving the head to ease the back of the leg and improve mobility.
instructions: Sit tall at the edge of a chair with your hands on the seat or resting in your lap.
Slowly straighten one knee while you lower your chin toward your chest.
Bend the knee back down while you lift your head and look up.
Keep the motion smooth and gentle, never forcing into a strong stretch or tingling.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps, then switch legs.
